'''Spectral filters''' were installed in the [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]] of [[S-EP1 security droid]]s. When used in conjunction with [[microscopic imaging system]]s, spectral filters could create a blinding flash burst that could be used to temporarily incapacitate an target.<ref name="EGTD" />
